The table holds case statuses only (LOV-CASE-STATUS). The harness also observes the following approval and notice changes, which are not case statuses:

- Approval: from WAITING, on approve, change and approve, or refuse, when the checks of §5 pass, to DECIDED, with final call APPROVED, APPROVED_CHANGED or REFUSED.
- Notice: from Generated to Approved when the notice is approved and the decision record is written.
- Notice: from Generated to Held, reason REFUSED_BY_APPROVER, when the notice is refused and the decision record is written.
- Notice: from Generated to Held when the template is withdrawn (R-LIT-04).
